content.title: 3 Ways to Cut API Latency in Half
content.subtitle: Practical fixes you can ship this week — no infrastructure rewrite required.

content.heading: Cache at the edge, not just in your app
body: A CDN edge cache (Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront) serves repeat GET requests in ~20–50ms instead of round-tripping to origin.
Set Cache-Control: max-age and an ETag so clients and proxies can skip the network entirely on a 304.
Invalidation is the hard part — scope cache keys per-resource, not per-endpoint, so one update doesn't wipe the whole cache.

content.statLabel: Median latency drop after adding edge caching
content.context: Measured across a Node/Express API moving from origin-only responses to a CDN cache layer with 5-minute TTLs on its read-heavy endpoints.
